label: Figure 6.1: A perfectly inelastic supply curve (PES = 0)
alt: A vertical supply curve at quantity Q: quantity supplied is the same at prices P1 and P2, so PES = 0.
caption: A perfectly inelastic supply curve is vertical at Q. Whether the price is P<sub>1</sub>, P<sub>2</sub> or any other level, quantity supplied stays at Q, so the percentage change in quantity is zero and PES = 0.
